body: We are excited to introduce the  Rocky Rover,  our latest custom-built camper van designed for a customer seeking the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and adventure. This van conversion features an elegant interior with light stained wood and beautiful white cabinets, creating a bright and inviting living space.

The Rocky Rover's interior is thoughtfully designed for versatility and convenience. The brand new custom converting couch/bed (exclusive to this build) provides a comfortable seating area by day and easily transforms into a cozy bed at night. The stainless steel sink and sprayer offer both hot and cold water, making meal prep and clean-up a breeze. Recessed dimmable ceiling lighting sets the perfect ambiance, whether you’re relaxing or getting ready for your next adventure.

The built-in shower with a privacy screen ensures you can freshen up anytime, while the Thetford Cassette toilet with mounting plate offers discreet and convenient bathroom access. The thoughtful layout and high-quality finishes make the Rocky Rover a true home on wheels.

The exterior of the Rocky Rover is equally impressive, designed to enhance your outdoor adventures. The FVCO roof rack provides additional storage space and supports three Renogy 100W solar panels, ensuring you have plenty of power for your off-grid explorations.
